source: NASA DONKI (Space Weather Database Of Notifications, Knowledge, Information)
note: Only CMEs with a predicted impact at Mars (WSA-ENLIL model). marsArrivalTime is the predicted arrival. This file was assembled from the DONKI response saved in docs/data/samples/donki-cme-2026-11-sample.json: the window had 2 CMEs headed to Mars, and the saved sample has the arrival time of one of them (the other, 2026-11-09T18:15:00-CME-001, is left out until the data is fetched again). Run scripts/fetch-donki-cme.mjs with NASA_API_KEY to rebuild it from a longer window.
